query: SELECT f.bbox,d.hash AS source,c.hash AS cached FROM faces f JOIN persons p ON p.id=f.person_id JOIN photos photo ON photo.id=f.photo_id JOIN derivatives d ON d.photo_id=photo.id AND d.variant='medium' AND d.format='jpeg' AND NOT d.hdr LEFT JOIN face_crops c ON c.face_id=f.id AND c.source_hash=d.hash AND c.bbox=f.bbox WHERE f.id=$1 AND NOT p.hidden AND photo.deleted_at IS NULL AND photo.status='ready'
